title: Figure 25: BioMEMS 4x4 microelectrode retinal array; Fig. 24 retinal prosthesis rendering
description: Two side-by-side figures. Figure 25 is a fundus photograph of a retina with a 4x4 microelectrode array placed on it, captioned "A BioMEMS-Fabricated 4x4 Microelectrode Retinal Array." Figure 24 is a translucent 3D rendering of a human head wearing glasses, labeled A-D for camera in the glass frame, wireless transmitter, extraocular electronic case (receiver), and intraocular implant electrode array, captioned "A Representation of the Retinal Prosthesis." Both cite a Brown University course webpage.
